description: This file defines a React custom hook 'useSimulation' that runs a 2D ODE simulation with features like adaptive timestep, obstacle collision detection, boundary bouncing, and scoring. It manages simulation state, executes numerical integration via Runge-Kutta 4, and provides controls for starting, pausing, resetting, and stepping the simulation.

methods.name: setFieldFromStrings
methods.description: Parses equation strings to set the simulation vector field.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the simulation to initial state based on challenge parameters.

methods.name: step
methods.description: Advances the simulation by one step when paused.

ctags.name: useSimulation
ctags.pattern: /^export default function useSimulation({ odeStrings, bounds, challenge }) {$/
